caption: The drawing depicts a wooden figure standing upright, with a rod extending vertically through its base. The figure is dressed in a dark blue long coat with lighter blue trim, and it wears a black, wide-brimmed hat. The figure’s facial features are simply rendered, with vertical black lines indicating the eyes, eyebrows, nose, and mouth, and it has shoulder-length gray hair. Each arm is extended outward and attached to a large, flat, paddle-shaped object. The paddles are beige or light brown in color, with one paddle oriented upright and the other downward, creating a symmetrical appearance. The figure’s legs and feet are visible below the coat, with brown shoes resting on a small circular platform. The background of the drawing is plain, off-white, and unadorned.
title: Whirligig
